description: Pinned Imagination Studio FastH3 workflow: 864x480, 124 frames at 24 fps, eight Euler steps, CFG 1 and 80% sparse TensorFold int8 transformer blocks. ComfyUI owns text encoding, sampling, projections and video/audio decoding. Generates one H.264 MP4 with sound from a prompt. Read-only checkpoint mounts feed a revision-bound writable model view; native int8 cache files are reused and incomplete writes are regenerated. 104 GB peak is an unqualified planning estimate. Physical Spark, video and audio-quality acceptance remain pending. MiniMax H3 Community License terms and territory information are recorded in the model.
title: FastH3 8-Step V2 TensorFold video and audio single Spark
